facts.value: At iBio (Immersive Bioscience and Biotherapeutics), we are committed to cultivating the leading scientific minds of the future. So, if you are interested in making a difference to the lives and health of others by exploring innovative solutions to complex challenges in health, disease and medicine-making, then iBio is the course for you.

facts.value: If you are passionate about the science of disease and medicines, creative and curious about the world around you, love a challenge and working in teams using scientific data to solve complex problems - we are too. So come and join the team at iBio.
